messages.author: 6f2082f13e0d68d6
messages.subject: Matrix multiplication logical error
parts:
Hi All,

I am trying to read a matrix from HDFS file and then find a matrix multiplication on it. Here is the code below. It seems some logical error in the reading the data from HDFS that causing matrix multiplication. please help me if I miss anything here in this code.

# Program to find Matrix multiplication
#@Terminal
#echo "1 0 0" >>/tmp/mat
#echo "0 2 0" >>/tmp/mat
#echo "0 0 3" >>/tmp/mat
#fs -put /tmp/mat /hdfs/hdfp/mat

#Matrix Multiplication expected results
1 0 0
0 4 0
0 0 9

#rmr Program to find Matrix Multiplication
m.map=function(k,v) keyval(.,v);

m.reduce=function(k,vv)
{
  m=matrix(0,3,3)
  for(i in 1:3)
  {
    r=as.numeric(strsplit(vv[i],split=" ")[[1]])
    for(j in 1:3)
    {
      m[i,j]=r[j]
    }
  }
  m= m %*% m
  keyval(NULL,as.matrix(m))
}

r=mapreduce(input='/hdfs/hdfp/mat',output=NULL,input.format="text",map=m.map,reduce=m.reduce)

x=from.dfs(r)

#Actual Output
0 6 0
0 0 3
2 0 0

messages.author: 6ac7e7dfbe4f6c38
messages.subject: Re: [RHadoop:#895] Matrix multiplication logical error
parts:
You could use the CSV format, then the v variable would  hold a data frame. Transform that to a matrix with as.matrix and use regular matrix multiplication.

Antonio

messages.author: 6ac7e7dfbe4f6c38
messages.subject: Re: [RHadoop:#895] Matrix multiplication logical error
parts:
That will work for as long as the matrix is small enough to be read in a single map call.  Beyond that you have to think in terms of block matrices, look at the lls example for instance.

Antonio
